Θεὸς δ' ἰδόντα, ἐδ' ἐν ἰσχύι φθόν[?]

page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a mask-like face with scrolls and volutes) is an engraving and is not transcribed. The Greek epigram lines are read from a small, uneven print; the letters marked [?] are doubtful. The date line reads "M: D, LXXXIII." with a colon after M as printed; this punctuation is uncertain. A small mark at the foot of the page is a stain or a faint trace, not text, and is left out. The headings "DIXI." and the place/date line are set as level 1 and level 2 heads; the level-1 caput of 11 is taken from the printed "XI" in the printed heading.
